title: Agent evaluation set
description: agents/<id>.eval.json: the evaluation set of custom agent <id> (§7.2, AG-4). A case passes when the answer is grounded, contains every `expect.contains` value and called every `expect.tools` tool. Every case must pass before the agent is published.

contains.description: Values the answer must contain (numbers match as written or rounded)

cases.question: Which material had the highest consumption last month?
How much steel is in stock?
